title: Mineral-Pathway Transcriptional and Molecular Responses to Spaceflight: A Multi-Omics Analysis of Astronaut and Rodent Data
description: Analysis pipeline, processed data, figures, and tables from mining NASA OSDR astronaut (Inspiration4) and rodent (Rodent Research) multi-omics data to identify mineral deficiencies linked to transcriptional and molecular responses to spaceflight. Includes RNA-seq, proteomics, metabolomics differential expression analysis, KEGG mineral-pathway gene sets, machine learning regression of serum mineral levels, cross-species concordance analysis, and systems biology atlas.
